name: AI Financial Intelligence Benchmark (AFIB)
description: AFIB is a multi-dimensional evaluation framework designed to assess financial analysis capabilities of large language models across five dimensions: factual accuracy, analytical completeness, data recency, model consistency, and failure patterns. It uses a dataset of 95+ structured financial analysis questions derived from real-world equity research tasks to benchmark models.
reputation: A new finance-focused LLM benchmark that is still early in adoption, with interest mainly from researchers evaluating financial reasoning and analysis capabilities.
notes: Benchmark evaluates multiple dimensions of financial intelligence including hallucination rates and data recency; compares multiple AI systems including GPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and SuperInvesting.
